hero.headline: CADASTRAL SURVEYS
hero.title: Know Your Boundaries, Build with Confidence

section1.headline: What is a boundary survey?
section1.description: A boundary survey determines the legal property lines of a parcel of land. Using advanced GPS, total stations, and historical land records, SmartGrid Surveying provides highly accurate maps that define property limits and identify any encroachments or discrepancies.

items.title: Avoid legal disputes
items.description: Prevent costly property line conflicts with neighbors by ensuring accurate boundary identification.

items.title: Ensure Construction Compliance
items.description: Build within your legally defined property limits to meet zoning and regulatory requirements.

items.title: Protect Your Investment
items.description: Know exactly what you own before buying, selling, or developing land.

items.title: Resolve Encroachments
items.description: Identify overlapping structures or fencing issues and take corrective action before they become major problems.
